sections.name: 听力 Listening
sections.intro: 大家好！欢迎参加HSK六级考试。HSK六级听力考试分三部分，共50题。请大家注意，听力考试现在开始。

parts.title: 第一部分
parts.desc: 请选出与所听内容一致的一项。
parts.audioIntro: 第一部分，共15题。每题听一次。每题都是一段话，请选出与所听内容一致的一项。

parts.title: 第二部分
parts.audioIntro: 第二部分，共15题。每题听一次。每题都是一段采访，采访后有几个问题，请选出正确答案。
parts.rangeIntro: 第{a}到{b}题是根据下面一段采访：

parts.title: 第三部分
parts.audioIntro: 第三部分，共20题。每题听一次。每题都是一段话，这段话后有几个问题，请选出正确答案。
parts.rangeIntro: 第{a}到{b}题是根据下面一段话：

parts.title: 第二部分
parts.desc: 选词填空。选出最恰当的一组词语。

parts.title: 缩写
parts.desc: 先用10分钟阅读文章，阅读时不能抄写、记录。10分钟后文章收回，用35分钟把这篇文章缩写成一篇400字左右的短文，标题自拟。只需复述文章内容，不需要加入自己的观点。
parts.prompt: 请把这篇文章缩写成一篇400字左右的短文，标题自拟。
parts.rubric:
Score 0-100 (HSK 6 缩写: retell a ~1000-character story in ~400 characters incl. punctuation, own title, no own opinions):
90-100 = has a title; keeps all the key events in order and the story's point; clear, coherent, well-paced summary; varied, accurate grammar and vocabulary; almost no errors; 350-450 characters
75-89 = title; nearly all key events, coherent; a few minor errors; length roughly right
60-74 = main story recognisable but some key events missing or out of order; several errors; or length clearly off (250-350 or 500+)
40-59 = only part of the story; frequent errors; hard to follow in places; or under 250 characters
20-39 = fragments of the story, many errors
1-19 = very little relevant content
0 = blank or unrelated
Deduct 5 if there is no title. Deduct 5 if the learner adds their own opinions/commentary. Deduct 1 per wrongly written character (max 10). Copying long phrases verbatim from the source is fine at HSK 6; inventing events that are not in the story is not.
